players.fate: The original hidden gem from CM 93/94 — 20/20 pace and flair. Pelé named him his successor. A heartbreaking real career across 13 countries.
players.hype: "Pelé said he'd be the next him. In the game, he genuinely was."

players.fate: THE Championship Manager legend. £2m to Dinamo Minsk and he scores 50 a season, every season, forever. Real life: injuries, retirement at 26, gone too soon in 2020. Mourned worldwide by people who never saw him kick a real ball.
players.hype: "Say his name to the right person and you make a friend for life. The icon."

players.fate: 132 goals in 32 youth games, broke Michael Owen's record, Liverpool bid £2m. In CM, a 16-year-old colossus. In reality, ~15 career goals across Finland, Greece and Norway.
players.hype: "The schoolboy who out-scored Michael Owen. Sign him before anyone wakes up."

players.fate: The ultimate ghost. A devastating forward in the game — and a player who NEVER EXISTED in real life. A research error, immortalised by a generation of managers.
players.hype: "Sporting's Portuguese sensation. Unstoppable on screen. Nonexistent everywhere else."

players.fate: £500k from Derby, 20 a season from midfield, guaranteed. One of the most beloved names in FM folklore. Never actually played for Derby — drifted through Scandinavia, now runs a seventh-tier club he founded.
players.hype: "£500k from Derby. 20 goals a season. A genuine cheat code with a beautiful name."

players.fate: Football's first global teenage wonderkid. Pro at 14, on magazine covers worldwide. Instead of Madrid: Philadelphia, then Serbia, then nowhere. The blueprint for hype outrunning reality.
players.hype: "The next Pelé. Signed pro at fourteen. Every stadium sold out to watch him."

players.fate: From Shakhtar he'd become one of the best players in your save, somersaults and all. A decent real career and a famous 2002 World Cup — but never the in-game god.
players.hype: "The somersaulting Nigerian. Turns into the best striker in your entire save."

players.fate: A Slovak goal machine in CM 01/02. Half-delivered — top-scored at the 2010 World Cup — but in-game he was a guaranteed 30-a-season man from teenage years.
players.hype: "Slovakia's teenage finisher. Goals guaranteed, fee laughably small."

players.fate: A Dynamo Kyiv gem — cheap, lethal, and capable of greatness in the right save. The real career stayed mostly in Ukraine, flashes of the promise but never the whole.
players.hype: "Dynamo Kyiv's teenager. A bargain who becomes a star — on your screen, at least."
